review.tagline: Collection of 93 runnable AI tutorials on RAG, agents, MCP and fine-tuning
review.summary: A monorepo of about 93 example projects, mostly Jupyter notebooks and small apps, grouped into beginner, intermediate and advanced tiers. Topics include local OCR, RAG with LlamaIndex and Ollama, CrewAI and AutoGen agents, MCP servers, voice agents, model comparisons and fine-tuning with Unsloth. Each project sits in its own folder with its own dependencies.
review.audience: Engineers learning to build RAG, agent and MCP apps from worked examples
strengths: Roughly 93 self-contained projects, each in its own folder
Wide coverage: RAG, agents, MCP, voice, OCR, fine-tuning, evaluation
Projects sorted into beginner, intermediate and advanced tiers
MIT license; many examples run locally with Ollama and open models
weaknesses: No single install; each project has its own dependencies and setup
Many examples need third-party API keys such as Firecrawl or AssemblyAI
Example code, not a maintained library; 'production-ready' claim is unsupported
No releases or versioning; project freshness and quality vary
needs: Needs Ollama, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Qdrant, Milvus, Firecrawl, AssemblyAI, Opik
Models: Llama 3.2, Llama 3.3, Llama 4, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3
